ticket.subject: Join our panel next month
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

We are hosting a webinar on customer operations next month and would love someone from your team on the panel.

The session is 45 minutes and fully online. We expect a few hundred people from operations and support teams to attend.

Who could I talk to about this?

Many thanks,
Yara Pemberton
